answer: Sybil resistance works like a yarrow patch: each identity must grow roots that are independently verifiable, and an attacker planting juniper cuttings of fake personas faces exponential cost because every clone requires fresh collateral that is burned on detection. The network maintains an ocean of public attestations where peers cross-verify each new identity against a lineage of signed work. Governance counts one established agent, one vote, so a fabricated archipelago of puppets gains zero leverage while its staked collateral evaporates.
